name: Kuroyuri no Yakata
source:
Postwar turmoil. Millions are driven to extreme poverty. However, there is a place of a dream-like luxury that exist as a mockery.
Main character is the second son who returns to this place - a western style mansion. What awaits him there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战后局势动荡，数百万人陷入极端贫困。然而，有一个宛如嘲弄世人的地方，依旧享受着梦幻般的奢华。
主人公是重返此地的次子，而这里是一座西式宅邸。等待他的究竟是什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
